title: A Verdict for the Cipher
author: Astrid Zhou
blurb: Mara Amberdale, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
